topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Employee handbook code of conduct; no security content; POL-01 4.12 sanctions effective 2026-09-08
gap: Code of conduct has no security or confidentiality commitments
remediation: Add security and NDA duties to the code of conduct and annual acknowledgment

control_description: Privately held LLC with no board; the President and VP Operations will review security quarterly from 2026-Q4
gap: No recorded leadership oversight of security before 2026
remediation: Record quarterly security reviews (POA&M, High risks, metrics)

control_description: POL-01 names the IT security lead, OT security lead, and Plant Manager isolation authority
gap: OT duties not yet in job descriptions
remediation: Update job descriptions for the IT Manager, Controls Engineer, and Plant Manager (P03 G-007)

control_description: Background checks at hire; annual training for office staff only; no OT security training
gap: No training for production and field staff; no role training for OT staff
remediation: Training program (POAM-017); OT role training (P03 G-038)

control_description: Policies assign owners; sanctions defined but not yet applied
IT inventory in device management; no OT inventory or data flow diagram
gap: OT inventory and IT/OT data flows missing
remediation: OT inventory (POAM-011); data flow diagram (P03 G-020)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies approved 2026-09-04; acknowledgments and reporting line not yet communicated to production
gap: Acknowledgments pending; production staff not briefed

control_description: No process for utility incident notices, vulnerability disclosure, or firmware hashes; no published security contact for customers
gap: Addendum communications not operating; 2 supplier advisories not disclosed
remediation: Obligations register; notification matrix (P08); disclose open advisories (P03 G-082 to G-086)

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Mission, critical services, and risk tolerance defined in POL-01 and P01
2026 risk assessment per SP 800-30 covering IT, OT, suppliers, and customer duties (P01, 34 risks)
Payment fraud and insider misuse assessed in P01 (R-004, R-016)
POL-01 requires reassessment after major changes; no OT change process
remediation: OT change procedure with Plant Manager approval (P03 G-042)

control_description: First control assessment 2026-08 (P07); no ongoing monitoring
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M with owners, approved by leadership 2026-09-04

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected in the SSP (74 controls); many partial or planned
gap: Many selected controls are partial or planned

control_description: General IT controls partly in place; OT controls largely absent

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Five policies effective 2026-09-08; procedures not yet written
remediation: Write procedures under each policy (P03 G-010)

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: SSO and MFA for IT; flat plant network; shared HMI and test PC logins; dual-homed MES
gap: Flat plant network and shared OT logins

control_description: Manager-approved onboarding tickets; no access reviews
9 ERP super users; MES accounts disabled up to 7 days late; utilities not told of 2 departures
Badge access to plant, offices, and both server rooms; escorts; CCTV (P07 PE-3 fully satisfied)
Laptops wiped before reuse; drive destruction without certificates

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Edge firewall with no inbound services; MFA VPN; but 3 always-on OEM cellular routers bypass the boundary
gap: Uncontrolled OEM remote access into the plant

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS and IPsec on all external paths; FCI and drawings emailed without labels; PLM and file server unencrypted
gap: Unlabeled FCI; unencrypted design data at rest

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on 140 office endpoints and IT servers; none on MES, kiosks, or HMIs; USB allowed on plant equipment

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Quarterly external scans only; no internal or OT scanning; no advisory monitoring

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: No security monitoring; EDR alerts unreviewed; no log review
remediation: MDR and OT sensor (POAM-006); log review (POAM-015)

control_description: POL-03 declaration criteria effective 2026-09-08; not yet operated
Ransomware runbook approved 2026-09-04 (P08); untested; OT retainer pending
No tested recovery; backups exposed; OT programs not backed up
IT changes ticketed; PLC, HMI, and MES changes made without records
BIA complete (P05); cyber insurance in place; no contingency plan
gap: No contingency plan or manual production procedure
remediation: Contingency plan with traveler kit (P03 G-032)

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Only the MSP SOC 2 report reviewed (Part B); no security terms for OEMs or the TMU supplier
remediation: Supplier tiering and terms (P03 G-012 to G-016)
